name: Symbiotic
desc: Permissionless shared security restaking protocol allowing any asset to secure decentralized networks.

farmingSteps.title: Acquire Supported LSTs or LRTs
farmingSteps.desc: Obtain wstETH, cbETH, or rETH on Ethereum mainnet.

farmingSteps.desc: Multiply point yields by participating in ecosystem partner vaults.

name: Fuel Network
desc: The fastest modular execution layer designed for Ethereum, powered by parallel transaction processing and the Sway programming language.

farmingSteps.title: Install Fuel Wallet
farmingSteps.desc: Download and install the official Fuel Browser Extension.

farmingSteps.title: Bridge Assets via Fuel Native Bridge
farmingSteps.desc: Bridge Sepolia ETH to Fuel Sepolia testnet.

farmingSteps.desc: Execute swaps between ETH and USDC and provide liquidity to verified pairs.

name: Babylon
desc: Trustless Bitcoin staking protocol bringing decentralized proof-of-stake security to PoS chains using native BTC.

farmingSteps.title: Setup OKX or UniSat Bitcoin Wallet
farmingSteps.desc: Ensure your wallet supports native SegWit or Taproot address formats.

farmingSteps.title: Deposit BTC into Staking Cap Pools
farmingSteps.desc: Stake BTC directly during Babylon phase caps to start accruing staking points.

farmingSteps.title: Delegate to Top Validators
farmingSteps.desc: Split allocations across multiple active network finality providers.

farmingSteps.title: Verify Points on Official Dashboard
farmingSteps.desc: Check the official Babylon staking leaderboard to track eligible epoch points.

farmingSteps.desc: Request testnet IP tokens from the official Story Protocol Odyssey faucet.

farmingSteps.title: Register Intellectual Property Asset (IPA)
farmingSteps.desc: Mint and register an on-chain IP NFT using Story Protocol SDK or partner dApps.

farmingSteps.title: Create Licensing Agreement
farmingSteps.desc: Attach commercial terms and royalty distributions to your registered IP assets.

farmingSteps.title: Interact with Ecosystem dApps
farmingSteps.desc: Swap and trade licensed IP on secondary marketplaces to record diverse contract transactions.
